description: Issue #867: neutralizes RequestBindingPolicy.IsPathAllowed's static-member guard (`if (IsStaticMember(member)) return false;`, src/WalkingTec.Mvvm.Core/Helper/RequestBindingPolicy.cs) with a compile-preserving `&& false` (not a deletion). The declaring-type/gateway-name guard on the following line stays intact -- which matters, because the ONE real static member on the production graph (WTMContext.ReloadUserFunc) is only reachable via 'Wtm', a name the gateway guard ALSO independently rejects; an HTTP-level test posting 'Wtm.ReloadUserFunc' would therefore stay green under this mutant for the wrong reason (caught by the untouched gateway guard, not proving anything about the static guard specifically) -- see this issue's own exhaustive-table analysis, section 4 point 2. This mutant is instead checked directly against RequestBindingPolicyTests867.IsPathAllowed_PublicStaticField_ReturnsFalse, which targets FixtureVM.StaticSecret -- a public static field whose name is NOT one of the curated gateway names and whose declaring type is neither BaseVM/BaseSearcher/WTMContext -- specifically isolating the static-member guard from the gateway guard. With the guard neutralized, IsPathAllowed(vm, "StaticSecret") returns true instead of false, which is what turns the assertion red. The green control, IsPathAllowed_SearcherDotCustomFilterField_ReturnsTrue, exercises a legitimate non-static Searcher.ZipCode path and is genuinely unaffected by this mutant.
target_symbol: RequestBindingPolicy.IsPathAllowed(Type, string, string) -- the `if (IsStaticMember(member)) return false;` guard condition

red_expected_assertion_patterns.WalkingTec.Mvvm.Core.Test.Helper.Request: must be rejected independently of the gateway-name check

red_expected_assertion_patterns_observed: Captured verbatim against a clean checkout with the mutant patch applied (stale demo.db under bin/ removed first): 'Assert.IsFalse failed. #867: Type.GetMember defaults to Public|Instance|Static, so a public static field is reachable through an instance path and must be rejected independently of the gateway-name check.'. Confirmed via python3 test/mutants/run_mutant.py --mutant wtmsec867-static-member-guard-neutralize: 'VERDICT: KILLED' / 'GATE: PASS'.
